upload_description_plain:
So a little while ago I posted a remix with an acappella (deflated & alone), and many people made many beautiful things. TSOL here created a gorgeous acoustic guitar piece and uploaded it, and I in turn decided to customize a vocal for it. In a way it is kind of redundant, but in other ways, it realizes my life's dream of being a Parisian jazz club singer. Just please let me have my dream, even if it isn't real?

Lyric
I remember everything
and I remember you
I'm the 24 ton elephant
hiding in the corner of the room/crying in the corner of your room (2nd time around)
I can feel you breathing
as I perceive the stench of her perfume
and as far as I'm concerned 
it's an unnecessarily heady brew
don't look back at me
as you raise the stakes
and break and break my heart
once again
it's three in the morning
and my soul isn't going to rise up singing
I won't spread my wings
or take to the skies
oh I yearn for you
what am I supposed to do

upload_description_plain:
Alt. mix :   http://ccmixter.org/files/VJ_Memes/35708
Dub Mix: http://ccmixter.org/files/VJ_Memes/36380?prompt=str_file_changed



I wrote this song years ago. I was playing the piano, to my left there was a bay window. A bus pulled up and a little girl with a back pack got out and stopped at the end of my driveway and just stood there swaying to the piano until I stopped playing. I remember the trees sort of looked like they were swaying in the wind too and that image has just stuck with me.

I originally called this song apoptosis, which translates into gentle death, like the falling of leaves from trees. In biology its programmed cell death, a natural and necessary process for life to persist. "trembling branch' is a martial arts practice (From Kenpo) much like Bruce Lee's "Be like the water" philosophy. 

Lyrics:

Be like a trembling' branch
Follow the waters ways

When a cool wind is blowin
Be like a trembling branch

We're fallin' like leaves from a tree
We're fading  like memories
We're fallin' like leaves from a tree
Under our feet we're pushin' daisies

It's ok just sway
Sway...my people sway 
Sway...and you won't break
Sway..my people sway 
Sway...and you won't break

upload_description_plain:
I thought I'd go ahead and take Admiral Bob up on his invitation to sing the blues with him on this track.  I've never really tried to sing the blues before, but I figured as long as I had this opportunity to play around with Bob's stuff, now would be as an appropriate time as any.  And as long as I'm singing the blues, I thought I should choose a topic that brings me constant grief and frustration: putting the kids to bed...

P.S.  I couldn't make up my mind on singing this in a lower or higher register, so I've uploaded the lower-pitched version as an alternate mix.

LYRICS

Well, my kids, you know they like to give me trouble at night. 
I say kids, hey, it's getting late.
Time to turn out the light.
They say dad, silly dad. 
That is not what we want to do.
We're going to play until 2 AM.  Until 2 AM!

Oh, please somebody help me.
Oh, please somebody tell me! 
What am I going to do with them? 
They want to play until 2 AM.

Well, I say kids, tell you what.
I am willing to make you a deal.
If you go to bed now, then tomorrow you can watch TV for an hour.
How do you feel about that?
They say dad, silly dad.
What do you take us for? 
You will have to offer us more than that, so much more than that! 

Oh please somebody help me!
Please somebody tell me!
What am I going to do with them? 
They want to play until 2 AM. 

Well, I say kids, listen up.
This is how it's going to go down.
You have to the count of ten to get your behinds into bed before I take away your video games. I ain't playing around! 

They say dad, please no dad! 
Take away anything but that! 
We promise to be good, not bad!
Won't you please give us one more chance.

I say alright. Good night. Turn the light out.
I don't want to hear anymore monkeying about.
